design_candidates.name: feature-isolated facade
design_candidates.reason: Removes textual source duplication immediately while preserving crate-private compiler/runtime boundaries and excludes LSP, quality, and benchmark modules from focused product builds.

design_candidates.name: runtime implementation crate
design_candidates.reason: No source duplication remains after facade ownership; extraction would expose a broad unstable private surface and increase compiler/runtime edit invalidation.

design_candidates.name: compiler protocol crate
design_candidates.reason: The current artifact types cross syntax, type checking, NativeIR, and image admission; a premature split would create conversion mirrors instead of one dependency-inward owner.

design_candidates.name: AST quality audit crate
design_candidates.reason: The syn and quote dependency load is unrelated to product builds and the extracted tool owns an acyclic read-only report boundary.

design_candidates.name: runtime ABI contract crate
design_candidates.reason: BoundaryError and TvmBoundaryType are stable dependency-inward AOT contracts shared by generated code and the VM without exposing mutable runtime implementation.

packages.name: terlan
packages.responsibility: Own the single shipped Terlan compiler, AOT runtime, VM, and feature-isolated product tooling.

packages.name: terlan-archive
packages.responsibility: Own deterministic archive creation and extraction primitives shared by release tooling.

packages.name: terlan-build-cache
packages.responsibility: Own compiler-independent Linux Rust incremental-cache inspection and lease-coordinated retirement without linking compiler or VM dependencies.

packages.name: terlan-foundations-adapter
packages.responsibility: Own the optional conversion from portable Terlan service events into Foundations telemetry without owning VM scheduling.

packages.name: terlan-process-owner
packages.responsibility: Own child lifetimes and bounded tool capture shared by VM capabilities and compiler-independent build/test tooling.

packages.name: terl-docs
packages.responsibility: Own reusable documentation navigation, blog indexing, and browser-search assets outside the compiler and VM crates.

packages.name: terlan-runtime-abi
packages.responsibility: Own stable typed AOT image transition and failure contracts shared across Terlan runtime boundaries.

packages.name: terlan-service-foundation
packages.responsibility: Own bounded host-independent service configuration, context, lifecycle, metrics, events, sinks, and structured values.

packages.name: terlan-storage
packages.responsibility: Own bounded volatile checkpoint storage and transactional SQLite durability without actor scheduling or replication.

packages.name: terlan-test-orchestrator
packages.responsibility: Own compiler-independent Rust test phases and durable direct-launch observations through shared process ownership.

packages.name: terlan-libpq
packages.responsibility: Own the generated Rust resource wrapper for the reviewed libpq C ABI.

packages.name: terlan-rust-boundary-audit
packages.responsibility: Own AST-based Rust canonical-type and build-boundary quality analysis without loading parser dependencies into Terlan products.

product.installation_contract: one Terlan version and one shipped VM product
